Container.Name: portkeeper
Container.Overview: Self-hosted companion for RomM that preserves game port releases and builds versioned packages from your own game files. No authentication: keep it on your LAN.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, archives, caches and build work

Config.Name: Library (RomM ports)
Config.Description: Where published packages go; point at your RomM ports folder when ready

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated addresses you open the web UI with, e.g. 192.168.1.20,tower,tower.local. Other addresses get 403 Unrecognized Host header.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (100 = users)
